evidence: objdump of terranx_original.exe: fill at 0x0062AB10 loads y,x,height,width in order, stores [ecx+0x58c]/[ecx+0x590], then performs both register adds (add edx,edi; add eax,esi) between the store pairs, then stores [ecx+0x594]/[ecx+0x598]; the identical interleaved order appears inline in decode_chunk's two 0xD arms at 0x0062AD9E-0x0062ADB4 (transparent) and 0x0062AE51-0x0062AE67 (opaque), where this is live in esi with no pending pushes.

Decks build/recovery/decks/fill-rect-v1/v2/v3 and the check-after-rect-plain run (19 spellings, both flag sets /c /O2 /Gy /GR- /GX /Z7 and /c /O2 /Gy /GR- /Oy- /GX /Z7): every plain-sum spelling (including x += width, width + x, and named sum locals) hoists both adds above the stores; every read-back spelling (rect[2] = rect[0] + width) anchors its adds after the first store only while reordering the first three loads; declaration permutations and operand swaps do not restore the load order; direct member stores and anonymous-union array stores compile to the 80-byte no-reload form, while the pointer-local store form reaches the recorded 98-byte extent with all four call operands reloaded.

Current src/flic.cpp keeps pointer-local stores plus plain sums in fill, decode_black_trans, decode_fli_copy, decode_fli_copy_trans and both inline decode_chunk arms; fill and decode_black_trans boundary-pass with references passing and fail only on bytes, confined to the store/add window — the same residual carries to decode_fli_copy and decode_fli_copy_trans, which share the block.
payload.hypothesis: The dirty-rectangle block's add placement is context-dependent scheduling, not a distinct source form: standalone, no idiomatic spelling interleaves the two sums between the store pairs (19 spellings measured: plain sums hoist both adds; read-back store-forwards rect[0] back and reorders loads), while the same block inlined in decode_chunk's two 0xD arms does interleave correctly because esi holds this with no pending callee-save pushes. The pointer-local store spelling stays the adopted form — VC6 invalidates its member-load cache for stores through a pointer local, reproducing the image's per-use operand reloads — and the residual add placement in the standalone bodies is a measured hypothesis-stop.
